The '''Rata Nebula''' in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] inside the core territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. It contained the [[Rhigar system/Legends|Rhigar system]], which was linked to the [[Csaus system/Legends|Csaus system]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]] and to the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla]] and [[Colonial Station Chaf system/Legends|Colonial Station Chaf systems]] by another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="TEA" />

The Rhigar [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Rhigar/Legends|same name]], which hosted a secret [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy|military academy]] operated by the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]], a military group of the [[Empire of the Hand]]. The nebula's [[Color/Legends|bluish-green]] haze was visible from Rhigar's surface.<ref name="RedSkyBlueFlame" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jagged Fel]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] stationed at Rhigar's academy, noted that rumors about the supposed return of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]],<ref name="RedSkyBlueFlame" /> a Chiss [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who had [[Death/Legends|died]] [[9 ABY/Legends|ten years]] earlier,<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> had recently spread throughout the Rata Nebula.<ref name="RedSkyBlueFlame" /> The rumors resulted from a plot by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Sinister Triumvirate]] of [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Flim (Human)|Flim]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]], and the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|Grodan Tierce]].<ref name="TNEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rata Nebula appeared in the short story "[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]," which was authored by [[Elaine Cunningham]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh issue]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine,<ref name="RedSkyBlueFlame" /> released on [[October 16]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011018.html|text=Live on the Fringe: ''Gamer'' # 7}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the nebula in grid squares E-9 and F-9.<ref name="TEA" />
